jobs.title: Chief Underwriter - Business Consultant
jobs.description:
Regional Account Chief UW GB - UO07EE

Sr Business Consultant - BB07AE

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

The Underwriting Senior Business Consultant position in Group Reinsurance Plus (GRP) is a dynamic position involving the application of product knowledge and technical underwriting skills to the best practices, training and quality management provided for the benefit of GRP and its reinsurance clients.  This position involves partnership with key underwriting and business contacts both internally and externally to deliver creative, yet practical solutions.

Your career here means leveraging your previous underwriting expertise in your new Shared Services role through collaboration, inclusivity, innovative thinking and so much more. Here, doing things the way they’ve always been done isn’t a part of the job.  Here, you’ll be putting your creative insights to work with the underwriting team and leaders, having a seat at the table with key decision makers. And you’ll have any number of opportunities for your career to grow in whatever direction you choose.

Responsibilities:

Best Practices
- Act as the gatekeeper of GRP best practices to ensure new guidelines, process and procedures, and related underwriting bulletin articles have been fully vetted.

- Work closely with GRP Underwriting Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and GB Underwriting Best Practices to ensure that GRP’s underwriting policies and procedures are reflective of current practices, where deemed to be applicable.

- Draft, peer review and publish new or revised content for our internal underwriting SharePoint sites and external underwriting manuals.

Training and Education
- Develop, deliver and maintain internal and client company training curriculum, including robust and pertinent case studies, training agreements, knowledge assessments and course evaluations, focusing primarily on the pricing protocols, risk assessment, financial analysis and other topics unique to Group Life, Disability and Supplemental Health.

Quality Management
- Perform internal quality management reviews for group life and disability, including rate development, policies and procedures, proposal and presale analysis memos, and provide thoughtful insight as to an individual’s areas of excellence and opportunity.

- Perform presale quality management reviews for reinsurance clients that perform their own underwriting as well as other special studies, audits and training reviews to gain insight into GRP or client underwriting practices.

- Develop and work with others to execute on action plans designed to improve the quality of GRP and client underwriting based on quality management results, such as enhanced best practices, training, revised underwriting authority limits, etc.

Strategic Reserve
- Act as strategic reserve and underwrite new business quotes, renewals and sold case submissions as requested during periods of high demand or limited capacity on other teams.

Other
- Lead and/or actively participate in various functional or cross-functional initiatives within GRP or with other areas within Group Benefits.

Qualifications:
- Group life and disability underwriting skills, preferably with 4 or more years underwriting experience including experience rated size segments.

- Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills, including ability to communicate to audiences with varying levels of expertise and job level.

- Proven analytical abilities with keen attention to detail balanced with the ability to see and make sense of the big picture, make recommendations and propose solutions.

- Demonstrated organization and prioritization management skills, including project management and ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced work environment

- Highly self-motivated, takes ownership and is able to work independently and with limited direction

- Group reinsurance, advanced product, continuous improvement and and/or change management experience preferred but not required.

***This position can be filled at different levels depending on experience

This role can have a Hybrid or Remote work schedule.  Candidates who live near one of our office locations will have the expectation of working in an office 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday).   Candidates who do not live near an office will have a remote work schedule, with the expectation of coming into an office as business needs arise.

Compensation
The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is:

86,400 - 138,600
The posted salary range reflects our ability to hire at different position titles and levels depending on background and experience.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Sex/Race/Color/Veterans/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity or Expression/Religion/Age

jobs.title: Digital Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
Digital Strategy Lead - ME07LE
We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

This role is part of our growing Digital Analytics organization. Digital Analytics is a high-impact team focused on delivering AI-first analytics, real-time insights, and personalization capabilities across our digital landscape to help business partners understand customer behavior, optimize experiences, and make confident, data-driven decisions at scale.

The Lead Digital Analyst serves as the strategic analytics lead for the Employee Benefits and Corporate domains, partnering closely with business and technology stakeholders to drive analytics strategy, priorities, and outcomes. This role combines deep hands-on analytics expertise with leadership responsibility for stakeholder engagement, work prioritization, delivery oversight, quality standards, risk management, and business outcomes.

In addition, the Lead Digital Analyst provides functional leadership and mentorship to a team of analysts, helping guide work allocation, analyst development, and delivery excellence while partnering with business and technology teams to deliver actionable insights and drive data-informed decision making.

Core Competencies
Analytics Leadership • Strategic Planning • Stakeholder Management • Advanced Analytics & SQL • Omnichannel & AI Traffic Analytics • Data Governance & Quality • Executive Reporting • Project Delivery • Process Improvement • Cross-Functional Leadership • Mentoring & Coaching • Communication & Influence.

Role Clarification
This is a lead analyst role, not a people manager role . The position provides functional leadership and accountability for analytics delivery, stakeholder outcomes, prioritization, quality standards, and analyst development while remaining actively engaged in hands-on analytical work.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead complex data and analytics initiatives, translating business needs into scalable, data-driven solutions.
- Serve as the primary analytics partner and trusted advisor for assigned business domains, providing strategic guidance and thought leadership.
- Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements, KPIs, and analytical solutions that drive informed decision-making and support scalable analytics solutions.
- Perform advanced analytics, data profiling, data discovery, SQL-based querying, omnichannel analysis, and Agentic AI traffic analysis to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and actionable insights.
- Oversee the delivery of complex analyses, reporting, dashboards, scorecards, performance measurement solutions, and executive-level insights while ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to analytics standards and best practices.
- Lead work intake, prioritization, capacity planning, and delivery coordination, effectively managing risks, dependencies, and cross-functional collaboration.
- Drive data governance, data quality, documentation, and continuous improvement through process optimization, automation, and reusable analytics solutions that improve efficiency and scalability. Collaborate and support AI First analytical initiatives.
- Lead data quality investigations and root cause analysis, MORs, MBRs, and executive reporting, communicating insights, recommendations, and business performance metrics to diverse audiences.
- Mentor and develop analysts through coaching, knowledge sharing, deliverable reviews, and best-practice guidance while fostering collaboration and accountability.
- Maintain strong business, technical, and domain expertise while remaining hands-on and supporting strategic cross-functional initiatives aligned with organizational goals.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Analytics, Business, Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.
- 6+ years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, digital analytics, reporting, or related disciplines.
- Experience leading analytics initiatives and mentoring or guiding analysts.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data storytelling skills.
- Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
- Experience working with cloud-based data platforms such as Snowflake, BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, and digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics/GA4.
- Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
- Ability to influence without authority and collaborate effectively across business and technology teams.
- Experience working in Agile environments and managing multiple priorities.
- Experience with data quality, reporting automation, dashboard development, and digital analytics best practices are preferred.
- Insurance or financial services experience is a plus.
- Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
- Experience analyzing digital customer behavior, customer journeys, or enterprise datasets.
- Experience driving process improvements and scalable analytics solutions.

Candidate must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship. The company will not support the STEM OPT I-983 Training Plan endorsement for this position.

The Director of Strategic Finance & Business Partnering – CIO serves as a strategic finance transformation leader supporting one of the company’s largest and most critical investment areas. This role partners directly with Technology and Segment Finance leadership to drive financial transparency, modernize forecasting and reporting, and enable faster, earlier, and more actionable insights across run and invest spend.

This position leads a team and is accountable for advancing the Technology Finance operating model by leveraging AI, automation, driver-based financial modeling, and cross-finance partnership to reduce manual effort, improve forecast quality, and deliver proactive insight into cost drivers, allocation impacts, and business outcomes.

Executive -Level Business Partnership & Influence
- Serve as a strategic advisor to Technology and Finance leadership, providing clear financial insights, recommendations, and decision frameworks
- Translate complex financial results, technology drivers, and allocation impacts into actionable guidance for executive decision-making
- Deliver concise, executive-ready commentary that moves beyond variance reporting to explain risks, opportunities, tradeoffs, and required actions

Segment Finance Partnership, Allocation Transparency & Technology Spend Management

- Partner with Segment Finance to evolve Technology allocation reporting, provide proactive transparency into direct and indirect allocation impacts - so segment impacts are understood earlier, explained consistently, and used to inform business.

- Leverage AI, automation, and reusable workflows to reduce manual effort, shorten cycle times, and improve consistency of leadership materials
- Redesign recurring reporting and Outlook processes so finance effort shifts from data assembly to insight generation, challenge, and decision support

Team Leadership & Capability Development

Investment Analyst, Public Credit Research
Overview of Position:
HIMCO is seeking an Investment Analyst to join the Public Credit Research team.
The Investment Analyst will work closely with senior analysts in Public Credit Research to analyze and underwrite new investment ideas and monitor existing holdings using our fundamental and relative value investment framework

Key Responsibilities:
- Assist in and provide individual contributions to the fundamental credit research process for new investment ideas and monitoring existing holdings
- Independently utilize financial information to build detailed financial models for companies as well as comparable company analysis with some help/oversight/assistance from the senior analyst.
- Proactively monitor company and industry news that may affect the fundamental outlook and/or relative value of our holdings
- Assist with and provide independent analysis for credit presentations to PMs and other internal/external clients
- Work independently to analyze credits and formulate investment recommendations and present views to Head of Public Credit Research and PMs
- Assist and provide substantial input into preparing credit recommendation updates that utilize our internal systems, including CATAGO, Bloomberg chats and virtual/in-person morning meetings. Begin to deliver content in these forums.
- Assist with and provide substantial input for ad-hoc projects, begin to support broader Public Credit Research projects

- 2+ years of relevant experience in credit research/fixed income, investment banking, equity research, accounting, corporate finance, or related investment role.
- Strong academic background, preference for bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics or quantitative (STEM) field

- Strong Microsoft Office (i.e., Excel, Powerpoint) and AI/data analytics skills. Knowledge of Bloomberg, Capital IQ or other financial statement data vendor a plus.

Assistant Investment Analyst - Municipal Credit Research

HIMCO (The Hartford Investment Management Company) is seeking an Assistant Investment Analyst to join the Municipal Credit Research team.  This individual will work closely with senior members of the team to identify, analyze, and monitor investment opportunities across the municipal bond market. The role combines fundamental credit analysis, relative value analysis, and the study of economic, political, and public policy developments that influence credit quality and market performance.
This position is well suited for a highly curious, self-motivated individual who is passionate about investing and the intersection of public policy and financial markets. The ideal candidate is eager to develop investment views, challenge assumptions, explore new analytical approaches, embrace AI and workflow automation, and contribute meaningfully to a collaborative research platform.

- Strong academic background with an undergraduate degree in Finance, Economics, Public Policy, Political Science, Government or a related field
- 0-2+ years of relevant experience in credit research, fixed income investing, public finance, government, or economic research
- Demonstrated intellectual curiosity in investing, public policy, financial analysis, and economics, and the ability to synthesize information from across these disciplines
- Understanding of financial statements, accounting concepts, and financial modeling
- Strong quantitative and analytical skills coupled with the ability to think critically and challenge conventional viewpoints
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and concisely
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; experience with AI and workflow automation applications such as CoPilot, Visual Studio Code, and Power Automate a plus

jobs.title: Intern, HIMCO Business Operations
jobs.description:
Student Intern - HHSIAN
We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

Hartford Investment Management Company (HIMCO)
Internship, Business Operations

Hartford Investment Management Company (HIMCO), a subsidiary of The Hartford Insurance Group, is committed to being a leading provider of investment management solutions.

About HIMCO

Hartford Investment Management Company (HIMCO) has been providing investment advice for over 35 years. With more than 130 investment professionals and approximately $120 billion in assets under management (AUM) across the fixed income, equity, and alternatives markets, we deliver tailored strategies to insurance companies as well as retail and institutional clients. Our mission is the pursuit of investment excellence centered on each client's success, and we have developed a culture that fosters debate and collaboration in an effort to drive value and results.

Why intern in Business Operations?

This is a great hands-on opportunity at a growing investment management company with affiliate and third-party assets under management. Interns will work across Business Operations, data, and technology initiatives, helping analyze processes, support reporting and data needs, and identify practical opportunities to improve efficiency, controls, and decision-making. This internship offers students a firsthand look at how business processes, data, and technology support investment management, with opportunities to collaborate across Business Operations, Portfolio Management, Trading, and IT through meaningful project work, networking, and a capstone presentation. Interns will also gain knowledge of fixed income, equity, derivative, and alternative assets with varying degrees of complexity.

About the internship

This is a 10-week experience designed to immerse interns in the buy-side investment management industry by working alongside one of HIMCO’s Business Operations teams. Assignments may include performance measurement and attribution, investment reporting, trade operations, data integrity, reconciliation and controls, valuations, or business process improvement. Interns may help document current-state processes, analyze data quality or reporting needs, support workflow improvement efforts, and contribute to initiatives that connect business requirements with technology-enabled solutions. Interns are offered development opportunities through mentoring, networking, business unit reviews, executive speakers, volunteering, and social events. Each intern’s contributions will culminate in a capstone project presentation to HIMCO senior leaders. Successful summer interns may be invited back for a full-time Business Operations position.

What are we looking for?

Our summer internship program is open to candidates pursuing a bachelor’s degree, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028. While no specific major is required, we are looking for highly motivated students with strong academic achievements, an interest in financial markets, and curiosity about how business, data, and technology intersect. We value candidates who bring fresh perspectives, ask thoughtful questions about how and why work is performed, and are comfortable proposing new ideas. Successful candidates will be interested in understanding existing processes, identifying potential improvements, and working collaboratively with business and technology partners to develop practical solutions. Candidate qualities we look for include:
- Curiosity, analytical thinking, and motivation to understand how business processes work and where they can be improved
- Strong academic achievement, related coursework, experience and/or interest in areas such as finance, economics, business, mathematics, computer science, engineering, data analytics, or business analysis
- Willingness to challenge assumptions, ask thoughtful questions, and identify more effective ways of working
- Interest in using data, reporting, automation, and technology concepts to solve business problems, improve processes, and support better decision-making
- Ability to collaborate with Business Operations teams, IT partners, Front Office and other technical stakeholders to translate business needs into practical solutions
- Strong attention to detail, initiative, time management, follow-through, clear communication, and comfort working in a collaborative environment with a proactive mindset.
- Interest in applying data and technology to improve business processes, reporting, controls, operational efficiency, and decision-making
- Familiarity with concepts such as data analysis, visualization, reporting, database design, business analysis, workflow automation, or generative AI
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office; exposure to tools such as Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, Python, or Excel VBA is a plus
